visual_action: A vertical split-screen video. The top panel shows Joe Biden, Ketanji Brown Jackson, and Kamala Harris walking out of the White House. The bottom panel shows the same three individuals walking down outdoor steps, with the backs of a crowd visible in the foreground. Everyone is smiling and dressed in business attire. The footage is in slow-motion.

on_screen_text.text: Introducing our next ✨ Supreme Court Justice ✨ Ketanji Brown Jackson

audio_music: An upbeat, celebratory instrumental track with a synth-pop feel plays throughout, creating a positive and momentous mood.
editing_pacing: The video uses a vertical split-screen to show two concurrent slow-motion clips of the same event. The pacing is slow and majestic.
central_claim: The Biden-Harris administration is proudly introducing Ketanji Brown Jackson as the next Supreme Court Justice.
intended_effect: To evoke pride and celebration for the appointment of Ketanji Brown Jackson and to associate this positive event with the Biden-Harris administration.
